title: No suite test pins identifier_of's reading of an inline flag, a group or a quantifier
goal: An existing test of _tools/test_bench.py asserts the unstated-names warning for an invented name written as (?i)Name, (Name|Other) and Name(?:s)?, so reverting identifier_of to the bare-name reading fails the suite; no new test id, tests_ceiling.json untouched

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/test_bench.py',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if '(?i)Set-InventedThing' in t and 'Set-InventedThing(?:s)?' in t else 1)

repro_reason: The defect is a missing assertion in the suite: the code works today (TK-xkceyjqo's check), so only the test file's text can show the assertion is absent; the fix's check is python3 _tools/tests.py -k bench_pool_check_reports_stale_pick with the code reverted failing it.
